errors.text_span: der von 0 bis 10 skaliert ist und in Abständen von 1 markiert ist
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis in the figure has no visible scale, tick marks, or labels. The description invents a scale from 0 to 10 with tick marks at intervals of 1, which is not supported by the visual evidence. The range is also incorrect as it includes a negative value (-1.5).

While technically correct that the bar for -1.5 has the shortest absolute length, the description fails to mention the more significant feature that this is the only negative value and its bar extends to the left of the zero-axis, unlike all other bars.
